title: Rewarded ad runtime recovery and immediate calendar rendering with app-start warm-up

included: Fix Firebase Android identity used by Remote Config so rewarded-ad configuration can be fetched.
Coalesce concurrent Mobile Ads initialization calls.
Render CalendarScreen from a protected prefetch snapshot before foreground reload completes.
Start group decorations independently after personal calendar data is available.
Keep app-start event warm-up from replacing a usable cache with an empty or partial response.
excluded: Remote Config values, rewarded unit IDs, free-pass policy, map configuration, onboarding, and existing unrelated working-tree changes.
Production data changes and any destructive device reinstall.

rootCause.rewardedAd: The installed Alpha 141 diagnostic log reached consent ready, but Remote Config fetch remained false and supplied default/empty rewarded unit configuration. The Android Firebase appId in lib/firebase_options.dart did not match android/app/google-services.json, preventing the intended Firebase configuration path from being used. The gate therefore stopped at unit_id_invalid before an SDK load/show attempt.
rootCause.calendar: CalendarScreen waited for foreground repository data before it could show events, even though app-start warm-up could already have a usable snapshot. A transient small foreground or warm-up response also risked replacing that snapshot.

implementation.firebase: Aligned Android Firebase appId with the authoritative Android google-services configuration; no API key, rewarded unit ID, or Remote Config policy value was changed.
implementation.ads: AdService now shares one in-flight initialize Future, preventing competing initialization paths from racing or duplicating work.
implementation.calendar: CalendarScreen synchronously seeds its first frame from EventPrefetchService, then performs the normal foreground reload. Personal-event rendering is the critical path; group overlays and instruction badges load independently. Both foreground reload and app-start warm-up preserve an existing usable snapshot when an implausibly small response arrives.
implementation.safety: The cache receives the same protected display snapshot that the foreground calendar renders, preventing a transient empty/partial response from poisoning the next first frame.

roleReports.assignment: Inspect rewarded-ad lifecycle diagnostics and calendar loading path without edits.
roleReports.result: Read-only findings: device log showed RewardedAdConsent ready, followed by rcFetch=false, default configuration values, and unit_id_invalid before any rewarded SDK load. Source comparison found Firebase Android appId mismatch against google-services.json. Calendar first-frame path had no synchronous prefetch seed.
evidence: Alpha 141 device diagnostic sequence: consent ready -> rcFetch=false -> unit_id_invalid -> gate outcome.

roleReports.result: Added coverage that concurrent AdService.initialize calls invoke the initializer once, CalendarScreen displays a prefetched event while repository reload is pending, CalendarScreen retains a protected snapshot after an empty foreground result, and app-start warmUp retains a usable cache after a suspiciously small response.

It was corrected so the cache stores displayEvents only, and corresponding regression coverage was added. Final review found no BLOCKER, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW findings in the scoped diff.

Use the rewarded flow after free usage is exhausted and capture a single attempt showing load -> show -> onUserEarnedReward -> AI conversation opened.
